requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Date of arrest in this case - the four-year filing deadline runs from this date
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Date of arrest in this case - the four-year filing deadline runs from this date
requiredBeforeFiling.why: no arrest fact is held for a record the platform has not seen
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the date of arrest, from the case papers or your Georgia criminal history report - the petition must be filed within four years of it

requiredBeforeFiling.printedContext: Court and county named in the caption - the court in which you were accused or convicted, and its county; or, where the felony charge was dismissed, the Superior Court of the county where the arrest occurred (State, Superior, Magistrate, Probate or Municipal; your own case papers name it, and the instructions page says who can confirm it)
requiredBeforeFiling.disclosureLabel: Court and county named in the caption - the court in which you were accused or convicted, and its county; or, where the felony charge was dismissed, the Superior Court of the county where the arrest occurred (State, Superior, Magistrate, Probate or Municipal; your own case papers name it, and the instructions page says who can confirm it)
requiredBeforeFiling.why: which court handled the case, and its level - State, Superior, Magistrate, Probate or Municipal - is data the participant's own case papers carry; the packet must not default to Superior Court
requiredBeforeFiling.participantMustSupply: the name and level of the court in which you were accused or convicted and its county - or, where the felony charge was dismissed, the Superior Court of the county of arrest; the clerk's office can confirm which court is right
